{{Quote|Hold them in the Security Tower&mdash;and keep it quiet. Move.|Lando Calrissian orders Solardo and the other guardsmen to remove Sheckil and his men|<ref name="Episode V" />}}
'''Pedar Solardo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]]. A former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], Solardo relocated to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and joined the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] after witnessing [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] guile against the [[Norulac Freebooters]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang that regularly raided Taanab.<ref name="SWI" /> He was working in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during Darth Vader's seizing of the city in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Solardo, alongside fellow Wing Guardsmen [[Corman Jeihn]], [[Helder Spinoza/Legends|Helder Spinoza]], [[Gir Endac]], [[Bialar Selis]], and [[Razell Tameron]], proceeded to ambush an Imperial unit led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sheckil/Legends|Sheckil]] while they were transporting [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to Vader's shuttle, having been secretly notified by Calrissian via Lobot.<ref name="Episode V" />

He had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a beard.<ref name="Episode V" />

==Behind the scenes==
A photo of this unnamed character appeared on the package of [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] first "Bespin Security Guard" action figure in [[1980]], and was likely an image of an extra on the set of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], though the action figure itself was based on [[Helder Spinoza/Legends|Helder Spinoza]].<ref name="SWSourcebooks">{{Facebook|username=star-wars-sourcebooks|url=notes/star-wars-sourcebooks/naming-the-cloud-city-wing-guards/714850175231759|name=Star Wars Sourcebooks|date=Mar 6, 2014}}</ref>
